title: Retrieve-then-Adapt: Retrieval-Augmented Test-Time Adaptation for Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2604.05379v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The sequential recommendation (SR) task aims to predict the next item based on users' historical interaction sequences. Typically trained on historical data, SR models often struggle to adapt to real-time preference shifts during inference due to challenges posed by distributional divergence and parameterized constraints. Existing approaches to address this issue include test-time training, test-time augmentation, and retrieval-augmented fine-tuning. However, these methods either introduce significant computational overhead, rely on random augmentation strategies, or require a carefully designed two-stage training paradigm. In this paper, we argue that the key to effective test-time adaptation lies in achieving both effective augmentation and efficient adaptation. To this end, we propose Retrieve-then-Adapt (ReAd), a novel framework that dynamically adapts a deployed SR model to the test distribution through retrieved user pref

translated_title: 检索后自适应：面向序列推荐系统的检索增强测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 序列推荐（SR）任务旨在根据用户的历史交互序列预测下一个项目。SR模型通常在历史数据上训练，但在推理时往往难以适应实时的偏好变化，这主要是由于分布差异和参数化约束带来的挑战。现有的解决方法包括测试时训练、测试时增强和检索增强微调。然而，这些方法要么引入了显著的计算开销，要么依赖于随机增强策略，要么需要精心设计的两阶段训练范式。在本文中，我们认为有效的测试时自适应的关键在于实现有效的增强和高效的适应。为此，我们提出了检索后自适应（ReAd），一种新颖的框架，通过检索到的用户偏好动态调整已部署的SR模型以适应测试分布。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ReAd的检索增强测试时自适应框架，通过动态检索用户偏好来高效调整已部署的序列推荐模型，从而在推理时应对实时偏好变化，实现了增强有效性与适应高效性的结合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ReAd, a retrieval-augmented test-time adaptation framework that dynamically adjusts deployed sequential recommendation models via retrieved user preferences, achieving both effective augmentation and efficient adaptation to real-time preference shifts.
